_comment: Per-agent tool permissions for the Pilot agent.
CRITICAL: Nasiko per-agent permission is DEFAULT-ALLOW. Sharing a connector enables it
for every agent its owner runs. Apply these rules BEFORE first deploy.
Tool names reach the agent namespaced as {connector-prefix}__{tool}, so every pattern
starts with * and matches either form.
UNVERIFIED: Nasiko's docs do not state how overlapping rules resolve (first match,
most specific, or block-wins). This file assumes most-specific wins with the trailing
catch-all as the fallback. Test with one allowed tool and one unlisted tool before relying on it.
Stances: allow | ask (returns -32001, needs human approval) | block (-32000).

_any_other_connector._why: Pilot reaches providers only through the mandate gateway. A second path to the same API is a second path around the mandate.

_notes.hetzner_server_create: allow, not ask: approval is already encoded in the signed mandate a human approved. A second prompt here trains operators to click through.
_notes.hetzner_server_delete: allow: rollback must work unattended, and the gateway itself refuses to delete any server not labelled with the calling mandate's id.
_notes.cloudflare_dns_upsert: ask: the only irreversible step. The platform-native half of the gate; the gateway independently verifies a signed Auditor PASS token bound to this mandate and server IP. Two mechanisms, neither sufficient alone.
_notes.anakin_scrape_submit: allow, but the gateway tool itself rejects any URL except the pinned pricing page. Nasiko rules match tool names only and cannot inspect arguments.
_notes.handoff_status: allow: read-only. Pilot learns whether an operator has registered the human-bought server and its address; it can never supply one.
_notes.handoff_prepare_and_register: DELIBERATELY NOT LISTED. The trailing catch-all block stops the Pilot agent from calling them. The operator reaches them with a different bearer (GATEWAY_OPERATOR_TOKEN) straight at the gateway, outside Nasiko, and the gateway itself refuses them to the agent credential (FORBIDDEN_ROLE). Do not add an allow rule for either.
_notes.catch_all: The trailing {pattern:*, stance:block} matters because the platform default is allow.
